about:
CBM Plastics, Inc. was founded in 2001 in Arthur, Illinois, as a family-owned and operated business. The company began with a focus on profile extrusion and custom plastic injection molding, later adding thermoforming to its capabilities.

Today the company operates as a single-source supplier for plastic components, offering custom injection molding, plastic profile extrusion, and thermoforming under one roof. In-house engineering support provides design consultation and development, while assembly and logistics services extend the offering beyond molding. The facility houses equipment for all three core processes, enabling production of a wide variety of plastic parts.

CBM Plastics serves customers across a broad range of industries, though the company does not publicly list specific sectors. Its client base includes businesses seeking custom plastic components, from prototype through production runs, with the flexibility to handle assembly and supply-chain coordination.

The company emphasizes a partnership model, stating that its primary goal is to empower partners to find and sustain success through effective, reliable product lines. It highlights in-house engineering as a way to save customers time and money, and promotes a single-house supplier experience backed by on-site equipment and a commitment to confidentiality and on-time delivery.
